mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.2% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days due to investor concerns about labor market weakening and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: If 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p <0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.2%, or if the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) signals conflicting pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates dampening growth.
failure_condition: If 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p <0.05) despite the dual trend, or if the interaction effect isn't statistically significant (IC <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 3% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower future rate hikes and improved economic stability.
failure_condition: If 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p <0.05) during the inflation drop, or if the regime conditions (late-cycle + low inflation) aren't met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply) over 6 months indicates robust production growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as excess supply reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: If 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05) despite the supply trend, or if supply growth isn't accompanied by corresponding economic indicators (e.g., GDP growth).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST (demand in thousands of units) above 1400 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased demand signals potential growth and investment opportunities.
failure_condition: If 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p <0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1400, or if the surge is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GDPC1 (demand) and falling INDPRO (supply) indicates weakening demand relative to supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate inflationary pressures and higher interest rates.
failure_condition: If 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p >0.05) despite the inverse trends in demand and supply, or if the interaction effect isn't statistically significant (IC <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy and improving labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p <0.05) during the regime conditions, or if the policy signals aren't sustained over the horizon.
